components.name: Install command
components.css: .ds-install{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:21px;width:min(100%,485px);min-height:64px;padding:10px 25px;border:1px solid var(--brass);border-radius:13px;background:transparent;color:var(--brass);cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s}.ds-install code{font:400 clamp(22px,2.15vw,33px) "JetBrains Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:-.035em}.ds-install span{color:var(--muted);font:34px "Space Grotesk",sans-serif}.ds-install svg{margin-left:auto;width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-width:1.5}.ds-install:hover{background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink)}.ds-install:hover span{color:var(--ink)}.ds-install:hover svg{stroke:var(--ink)}.ds-install:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-install{transition:none}}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Plain navigation with readable hit areas.

components.name: Product window
components.description: Flat frame and caption around production media.
components.css: .ds-window{margin:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif}.ds-window figcaption{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:14px}.ds-window a{color:var(--paper);text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-window a:hover{color:var(--brass)}.ds-window a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Documentation code
components.description: Scrollable command evidence on the secondary surface.

narrative.overview:
The public site extends Chaching’s established Register & Receipt identity: warm ink, brass controls, off-white type and cream thermal receipts. Strong display type carries the gallows humour; quiet borders and generous spacing give real product evidence room to speak.

The existing Chaching! lockup stays unchanged. Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono are self-hosted from the bundled product fonts. Production dashboard and receipt imagery retains its renderer’s palette and uses fictional fixture data.
keyCharacteristics: Warm register surfaces and brass interaction cues.
Large, tightly set headlines with readable supporting copy.
Real product captures and tactile receipt paper.
dos: Do inherit the shared Register & Receipt tokens and bundled fonts.
Do use actual production renderers with fictional data for product evidence.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, readable text and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't redraw the dashboard or terminal as marketing evidence.
Don't recolour the existing wordmark or production receipts.
Don't describe the implemented monthly Wrapped recap as yearly.
